conversations..read: auth != null && ((query.orderByChild == 'requesterId' && query.equalTo == auth.uid) || (query.orderByChild == 'ownerId' && query.equalTo == auth.uid))

$conversationId..write: auth != null && ((!data.exists() && newData.child('requesterId').val() === auth.uid) || (data.exists() && (data.child('requesterId').val() === auth.uid || data.child('ownerId').val() === auth.uid) && newData.child('requesterId').val() === data.child('requesterId').val() && newData.child('ownerId').val() === data.child('ownerId').val()))

$messageId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['senderId', 'text', 'createdAt']) && newData.child('senderId').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('text').isString() && (newData.child('text').val().length > 0 || newData.hasChild('attachment')) && newData.child('text').val().length <= 2000

attachment..validate: newData.hasChildren(['url', 'name', 'type']) && newData.child('url').isString() && newData.child('url').val().matches(/^https?:\/\//) && newData.child('url').val().contains('/api/media/messages/' + $conversationId + '/' + auth.uid + '/') && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('name').val().length <= 200 && newData.child('type').isString() && newData.child('type').val().matches(/^(image\/(jpeg|png|webp)|application\/pdf)$/)
